scope: Public primary-source research only. No account interaction, vendor contact, procurement order, payment, or CAD change.
conclusion: Global Sourcing/pre-order is a supported route for the exact QFN driver, but the public pages do not expose its current JLC procurement price, MOQ, attrition quantity or supplier availability. A firm complete-assembly total cannot be inferred from public catalogue or DigiKey prices. Obtain the signed-in supplier quote before ordering.

required_part.package: TI RGE 24-pin 4x4 mm VQFN exposed pad
required_part.additional_attrition: Not verified; use JLC order-specific calculator. Do not assume zero.
required_part.substitution_warning: DBQ/DBQR SSOP package and TLC59283 are not approved replacements.

procurement_routes.path: Sign in → Parts Manager → Order Parts → Global Sourcing Parts → exact MFR part search → supplier/quantity quote
procurement_routes.public_terms_summary: Suppliers and quantities determine pricing. Ordinary inbound shipping is free; oversized shipments can cost extra. Some categories attract duty/inspection charges; these are not established for this IC. Loose untaped parts have preparation fees. No assembly storage fee. Warehouse receipt precedes PCBA use. Paid purchases cannot be cancelled/returned.
procurement_routes.sourcing_business_days: Normally 9–20 in detailed guide; 9–15 days in overview. Exact offer governs.
procurement_routes.universal_percentage_procurement_fee: No such rate published in the inspected official guide; do not invent one.

procurement_routes.public_terms_summary: Non-stock extended parts can require MOQ. The exact price may be confirmed within48hours after initial payment, then refunded or topped up. Inventory is for JLC assembly; do not treat an initial pre-order price as a final landed quote.

global_sourcing_guide.selected_categories: 3%–30% customs fees for some components; examples include relays, modules and cables. This does not establish a tariff for TLC59282.
global_sourcing_guide.commodity_inspection: $20 per affected part kind; switches/fuses/batteries etc examples. Not established for TLC59282.
global_sourcing_guide.loose_untaped_components: ≤5pins:$0.017/pin; >5pins capped$0.078/component. Conditional, not automatically added to taped QFN.

additional_published_charge_details.pickup: Not needed. Parts pickup incurs separate fees; do not add pickup fees to parts consumed in JLC assembly.
